<div class="card-body">
'''Conquest''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] ([[Capital]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊コンクェスト</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">6名のパイロット、8名の乗客、2台のビークル、4機のTIEを乗せられる。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値1の専属パイロットが乗っている。ファルコンに対して戦闘を宣言した後、反乱軍の手札を見ることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Conquest-PSA-161939283.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ミレニアム・ファルコンをタトゥイーンから追跡した帝国軍艦艇の1隻。光速に突入する直前のファルコンをスキャンした。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Conquest.

'''Card text:'''
May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Has docking capability. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard. After declaring battle against Falcon, you may look at the Rebel hand.

'''Lore:'''
One of the Imperial ships that chased the Millennium Falcon from Tatooine. It scanned the Falcon just before it jumped to lightspeed.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese looks at the Rebel hand after declaring battle against Falcon.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Conquest]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
